face.name: 校长克尔苏加德

face.text: Battlecry: Summon two 2/1 Shades. Each gains a Deathrattle to cast your last Shadow spell.

face.name: 暗脉女勋爵
face.text: 战吼：召唤两个2/1的阴影。每个阴影获得一个亡语以施放你的上一个暗影法术。

preaudit: Keep all ten actual missing roots. Lyra uses full Priest-spell generation and Putricide full real Concoction assembly identities, without executable filtering. Asvedon consumes actual last opponent played-spell history; Jace original own Fel spells and existing enemy preference; Lynessa original friendly-minion target facts; Rommath original outside-initial-deck spell identities and real once-per-game use. Tess and Murozond require actual played other-class/opponent previous-owner-turn card identities, complete supported non-spell bodies and explicit native replay policies rather than guessed generic casts or illegal Battlecry substitution. Headmaster Kel'Thuzad needs actual original Spellburst-cause deaths; Darkvein exact2/1 Shade and original last Shadow spell material retained through each true Deathrattle. Inspect all complete primary child roles, existing memory/history/replay APIs and any real minimal gaps; empty childIds and prefixes do not prove dependency closure. Version/CN edges and all six original domains remain open.
